cases.note: alone: claim, read, take over, serve
a live incumbent: stand by and follow it, no retry; a stray timer is ignored
takeover after a crash: the withdrawal heard live, read, the vacancy confirmed, take over (§2.8)
a withdrawal that is no vacancy: the read shows the incumbent again, stand by (core §8.1, 0.37)
a withdrawal, then a read not complete: stand by, and retry after the interval
an unreadable claim set: stand by and retry, never the only candidate; then take over (§2.5 step 3)
a lower candidate: stand by and retry; it took over meanwhile, so follow it
a lower candidate that leaves without serving: the retry finds the claim set without it, take over
a split healed: another holder appears, two reads a grace apart, the higher steps down in reverse order (§2.9)
the same split, from the lower: it stays serving
an appearance that is a re-mint's overlap: the first read shows two, the second one, so no split
an appearance gone by the first read: no grace armed, back to serving
its own heal read missing its own token still counts it: it knows it holds
its own token heard appearing is no heal
an appearance while it takes over is kept: the heal starts once it serves
a withdrawal while it steps down is kept: it campaigns once it stands by
after a step-down it follows the lower incumbent: a later withdrawal starts a campaign
a read nothing waits for is ignored
start twice: the second is nothing
a lock event under claim is nothing
external without the lock: claimed, standing by, no retry; a withdrawal is nothing (§2.11)
external: the lock taken, a read, no other holder: take over
external: the lock taken before the claim: the claim's end campaigns
external: the lock taken while a crashed holder's token lingers: wait on the watch for the vacancy
external: no heal by ids, whatever appears
external: the lock lost while serving: step down
external: the lock lost while taking over: step down once it serves
external: the lock lost while campaigning: the read finds it without the lock
external: a read not complete with the lock: retry
external: a lower candidate is no reason to wait, the lock decided
an appearance heard while it campaigns is kept: the takeover then reads for a heal (text 0.2, F-199)
a withdrawal heard while it campaigns is kept: the read that stands it by on the incumbent reads again (text 0.2, F-199)
an appearance kept while it campaigns, the read showing that holder: stand by on it, the appearance spent
a withdrawal kept while it campaigns, the read taking over: the withdrawal spent
a heal's first read not made shows one holder, which ends nothing: it reads again after the retry interval (text 0.2, F-199)
a heal's second read not complete showing one holder: the second read again after the retry interval, the first kept (text 0.2, F-199)
only a complete read showing one holder ends a heal (text 0.2, F-199)
an appearance heard while a heal's read runs, the read ending the heal: it reads again (text 0.2, F-199)
a withdrawal heard while a heal's second read runs, the heal stepping down: it campaigns once it stands by (text 0.2, F-199)
external: a withdrawal kept while it steps down for the lock it lost is nothing; the lock's return campaigns (text 0.2, F-207)
its own re-mint is no appearance: the new id is its own from then on, and so is the former one (text 0.2, F-209)
after its re-mint, a heal read counts its former id as its own: the overlap is one holder (text 0.2, F-209)
a standby's re-mint: its claim under its former id is its own, never a lower candidate (text 0.2, F-209)

description: redundancy.v1 §2.5 to §2.11: one candidate own of a governed interface, its election, and the events its runtime hands it in order -> the step each returns, and its role after the last. Events: "start" (begin: claim before reading); "finish" (the act the last claim, take_over or step_down asked for is done); {"read": R} (the read a read step asked for, R as elections.json writes one); {"appeared": id} (its watch heard that instance's interface token appear); "withdrawn" (its watch heard the address's interface tokens withdrawn, none left held); "timer" (the timer the last step armed fired: the retry interval, or the grace); {"lock": bool} (under external, the lock taken or lost); {"reminted": id} (its own re-mint: id is own from then on, and every former id is own too, never another holder or candidate; text 0.2, F-209). Steps: {"step": "claim"} (put the descriptor marked standby, declare the instance token and the watch, then finish); {"step": "read"}; {"step": "grace"} (arm the grace timer); {"step": "retry"} (serving, arm the retry timer: a heal read not complete showing fewer than two holders; text 0.2, F-199); {"step": "stand_by", "why", "instance"?, "retry"} (stand by; arm the retry timer when retry; why as elections.json's, or no_lock; retry is false for incumbent and no_lock, true otherwise); {"step": "take_over"} (core §8.2's order, then finish); {"step": "step_down", "why": "lower_holder" with instance, or "lock_lost"} (the reverse order, then finish); {"step": "nothing"}. The machine: a read is first read with every former id of own as own (F-209); start, once, is claim; finish of the claim campaigns (a read, or under external without the lock stand_by no_lock); a read while campaigning decides as elections.json (under external without the lock, stand_by no_lock), take_over or stand_by; finish of a take_over serves, then under external without the lock steps down lock_lost, under claim with an appearance heard while taking over reads (the heal's first read), else nothing; while serving under claim, another instance's appearance reads; that read's holders, own counted whether it shows own or not, two or more arm the grace, one from a complete read back to serving, one from a read not complete retry (text 0.2, F-199); the grace timer reads again; that read's holders, own counted, decide as heals.json with the first read's: step down lower_holder; no split from a read not complete, retry; else back to serving; the retry timer reads again, the second read again when a first is held; finish of a step_down stands by; while standing by, a withdrawal campaigns (under external only with the lock), a timer campaigns only when the stand_by armed retry; under external, a lock taken while standing by campaigns, a lock lost while serving steps down lock_lost, otherwise it is only remembered. What is heard meanwhile is kept (text 0.2, F-199): an appearance of another instance's token while campaigning, taking over or a heal read is asked, and a withdrawal while campaigning, stepping down or a heal read is asked; at that read's decision, or that act's finish, each kept event is decided as if heard then, in the state the decision leaves (an appearance first, then a withdrawal), and the first that asks something replaces a stand_by or a nothing, while an act's own phase keeps what it keeps: so an appearance kept through a take_over reads for a heal once it serves, a withdrawal kept past a stand_by reads again, one kept through a step_down campaigns once it stands by, under external only with the lock, else nothing (F-207). Its own token heard appearing, or a former id's, is nothing (F-209). Every other event in every other state is nothing, and changes nothing. role: "unclaimed" before the claim's finish, "standby" while campaigning, standing by or taking over, "serving" while serving, healing or stepping down.
